headline.exact_shape_definition: a declared registry value that (a) can switch a detector off or short-circuit its verdict, (b) has a code-derived truth it can diverge from, and (c) fails OPEN (toward an unearned green)
headline.honest_statement: The sweep did not find five more has_substeps. It found ONE more field of the identical shape (asset_kind/asset_type='service') and FIVE fields that gate a check but have no code-derived counterpart to be reconciled against — those are declarations that must be JUSTIFIED, not DERIVED, and they are reported as a distinct tier rather than inflated into the same finding.

tiers.A: IN SCOPE — exact D-25 shape: gates a detector, code-derived truth exists, divergence is measurable, fails open.
tiers.B: IN SCOPE — gates a detector, but NO code-derived truth exists. The declaration is the only source there is; it can only be justified, never derived. Reported plainly rather than invented into tier A.
tiers.C: EXAMINED — NOT in scope. Field supplies a value to a check, or its null-ness fails CLOSED (conservative), or no check depends on it.

findings.consequence: The probe/regenerate primitive is dead code in production today. findings.current_value: 35 rows carry target_floor=0; 25 rows carry NULL.
findings.code_derived_truth: NO code artefact declares an asset's correct floor. But CLAUDE.md §N.4 supplies the discipline that plays the same role: target_floor is to be SET TO THE MEASURED ACHIEVED COUNT AFTER A BUILD. Under that rule target_floor=0 means 'a build ran and honestly produced 0'; it cannot distinguish that from 'never built'. The volume_explanation requirement (C-21) is the mechanism intended to carry that distinction, and it is absent on 19 of 35.
findings.doctrine_tension_reported_not_resolved: CLAUDE.md §N.4 says floors are ASPIRATIONAL, NOT GATES. In classifyStuckCandidate and deriveState, target_floor=0 IS a gate — the only one of its values that is. This sweep reports the tension and does not resolve it; the disposition is ADHIKARIN's.

what_this_sweep_did_not_do: It did not repair anything. No write of any kind was issued against the database (I13/I14).
It did not resolve the CLAUDE.md §N.4 tension G-06 surfaces (floors aspirational vs target_floor=0 as a gate). That is ADHIKARIN's.
It did not audit non-asset_registry gating fields (asset_throughput.state, build_run_assets.state, build_protected_assets). D-25 part 3 is scoped to the registry.

It did not verify that the 8 service-declared rows in G-03 are WRONGLY declared. Several may be correct services. The finding is that the declaration alone produces the green, not that the declaration is false.

It did not re-run the writer census; it consumed 00_ARCHITECTURE/control/writer_substep_census.json (M0-T8) as the code-side truth for G-01 and G-02, and cross-checked has_writer with an independent @register scan whose one disagreement (mi_sankalpa) it traced to its own regex and discarded.
uncertainties: has_substeps was being repaired concurrently. Both readings are recorded; neither is asserted as final.

G-03's severity depends on how a reader weighs 'service_ok'. It is in plan.ts's READY_STATES, so it is load-bearing for dependency resolution — but whether an always-green service badge is a defect or a deliberate simplification is a judgment this KARAKA does not make.
G-04's consequence assessment ('dead code today') rests on rebuild_on_probe_fail being false on all 128 rows AT THE TIME OF READING. Nothing prevents a row from being set true later.

The tier-C dispositions rest on grep coverage over platform/src, platform-mcp/src, platform/python-sidecar, platform/scripts and 00_ARCHITECTURE/control. A consumer outside those trees, or one that reads the column through a SELECT * into a generic record, would not have been seen.
